about: Curated organiser names for Lisbon Fringe (work/23). Organisations only, never private people; no contact details. Each entry gives the canonical name and the spellings found on organisers' public event pages that fold into it. Events and counts are derived from events.json at build time. Organisers not listed here are named as the first event page names them.
